The amount released by Shivraj Singh Chouhan for the VB-G RAM-G scheme in July 2026 was ₹25,863 crore (US$2.7 billion) [1]. 

FINAL: ₹25,863 crore.

hits.text: 5 July – Union Agriculture and Rural Development Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan releases the first instalment of ₹25,863 crore (US$2.7 billion) to states for the implementation of the VB-G RAM-G scheme.
The VB G RAM G law comes into effect replacing MGNREGA.

An investigation by The Indian Express reveals that Union minister Bhagirath Choudhary received ₹99 lakh (US$100,000) as subsidy under his ministry for his commercial cucumber farm. Choudhary rejects the allegations and says that there was nothing irregular about availing the subsidy as he had engaged in farming long before entering politics.
The Uttar Pradesh government announces increase in wages of some workers following the 2026 Noida workers protest.
April – June – November – 2026 Rajya Sabha elections.
